scenes.title: Read-only access
scenes.subtitle: For partners, auditors and new joiners
scenes.narration: Some people need to see the business but not change it: a partner, an auditor, or someone in their first week. That is the view-only role.
Leela can open leads, contacts and itineraries, but there is no New button and nothing to edit.
She can read invoices and payments too. And it is not just hidden buttons: the server refuses any change from a read-only account.

scenes.headline: The right access for everyone.
scenes.narration: TravelCRM Pro. The right access for everyone.
